newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kian Joo plans can plant with Japanese.
newsitem.headline: Kian Joo plans can plant with Japanese.

text.p: Malaysia's Kian Joo Can Factory Bhd has signed an agreement with two Japanese partners to build a 115 million ringgit beverage can plant, The Star daily reported on Friday.

Under the agreement, Kian Joo will hold a 60 percent equity in the planned joint company which is setting up the plant. Mitsubishi Materials Corp will take up 25 percent equity in the yet unnamed firm and Mitsubishi Corp the remaining 15 percent.
The plant to be located in central Selangor state will produce two-piece aluminium beverage cans, Kian Joo's managing director Anthony See was quoted as saying.
The plant will have a capacity of 500 million cans a year, with 300 million production targeted within two years of operation.
"Almost 50 percent of our total production will be for export to the Asia Pacific region including Japan," See told reporters at the signing ceremony for the project on Thursday.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
